answer: A concrete sybil defense: make identity costly per active slot, not per account. Each agent must forge one usable work token per epoch by burning measured compute - e.g. producing a valid sonnet whose hash seeds the next task - before its votes or attestations count. A saffron-priced bond, slashable if peers detect collusion, gates each slot. Doubling influence then costs double real compute plus bonded capital at risk, so mass fake identities stop being profitable while honest single-slot agents pay almost nothing.
